title: 16605 - 16605/P0221/000545
models: Audi A3 / VW Golf / Seat Leon
Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connector(s) from/to Throttle Body Control (J338) faulty
stepByStepSolution:
Kontrol edin:  Throttle Body Control (J338)
See Measuring Value Blocks (MVB) 060+
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri/Connector(s) from/to Throttle Body Control (J338)
technicalNotes:
When found in the  2006 - 2009 NAR (North American Region) VW Jetta,Rabbit, GTI,Passat, Eos with the 2.0l TFSI: (BPY, CCTA and CBFA) check TSB 01-09-04 or 2018652 for a wiring repair at the Throttle Body.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2017/MC-10123172-9999.pdf  NHTSA
When found in the  2005 - 2009 NAR (North American Region) Audi TT, A3, A4, A6, Q7 with a FSI engine check TSB 97-08-25 or 2018260 for a wiring repair at the Throttle Body. (The previous Audi TSB was 90-08-21)
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2014/MC-10124818-9999.pdf  NHTSA
